name: expand-product
job: Scale a validated product core: bottleneck, highest-slope change, run the path you changed.

inScope: Framing the validated core and ×N target
Measuring the binding constraint and choosing one scale bet
Implementing on the correct layer with minimum observability
Running the path you changed and spot-checking the core journey
outOfScope: Scaling a broken core or greenfield reinvention
Pure cosmetics and rewrites without scale slope
Hacks that cannot survive the target ×N

inputs: Validated core and ×N target (users, surfaces, or capacity)
Cost, latency, compliance, and ownership constraints
outputs: Scale bet implemented on the path you changed (or externally blocked)

permissions: delivery access on the owning layer

failureSemantics: Do not invent a scale metric. The cycle is done when the scale bet is implemented on the path you changed, the core journey still holds, and new burden is recorded.

outcome.observable: The scale bet is implemented on the path you changed (or externally blocked), the core journey still holds, and the new maintain/finish burden is written down.
